name: @craft_eco/craft-mcp

tools.name: craft_game_info
tools.description: Show Craft version, supported engines and game-making instructions. Supply name to read an existing game engine and context, or engine to inspect the matching 2D/3D guide. Asset-source choices follow that engine AGENTS.md, relevant skills and user requirements.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

engine.description: Choose js for 2D/Phaser, js3d for 3D/Three.js. New games default to js; existing games keep their saved engine. Never change an existing game engine.

tools.name: craft_game_prepare
tools.description: Create or attach a Craft game and bind the current host context. Existing code and other host bindings are preserved. Poll to completion and read returned context. Use upgrade_context or context_bundle_id only for an explicitly requested context migration/update/rollback; ordinary recovery keeps its pinned version.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

engine.description: Choose js for 2D/Phaser, js3d for 3D/Three.js. New games default to js; existing games keep their saved engine. Never change an existing game engine.

upgrade_context.description: Explicitly adopt the installed context for this host, including migration of a legacy lock

context_bundle_id.description: Explicitly select an already retained context bundle for this host; mutually exclusive with upgrade_context

tools.name: craft_assets_generate
tools.description: Generate and import 1 to 8 assets when selected by the current engine context and user requirements: image/image_edit, static_mesh, skeletal_mesh, music, video, sprite_sheet or animation (video_url + model_resource_id). Use assets[].kind; inspect craft_game_info.aigc for capabilities. Platform charges automatically. Reuse request_key after failures or restart; never repeat an uncertain paid submission with a new key. Poll craft_task_status and wire the returned config_file slots into the game.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

images.description: Legacy image-only batch. Use assets for all resource kinds; do not send both.

tools.name: craft_assets_search
tools.description: Search the Craft asset library without generating assets. Read craft_game_info.library for categories matching the saved engine. Submit 1 to 8 slot/category/query entries; inspect candidates, scores, metadata and per-slot errors. Poll craft_task_status, then import chosen source=library with search_id/candidate_id. No arbitrary URLs or external search credentials.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

tools.name: craft_assets_import
tools.description: Import existing AIGC outputs by resource_id, or selected library candidates with source=library, search_id and candidate_id. One source per batch. Never generates assets. Preserves the original AIGC URL or library Path and updates engine configs/controls without downloading payloads. Poll craft_task_status.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

tools.name: craft_assets_status
tools.description: Read durable asset requests and import results for the current account and project.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

tools.name: craft_game_check
tools.description: Finalize engine exports, build, exercise the core loop, settlement and restart, and capture real screenshots. Each step must assert real snapshot().game fields. Poll craft_task_status, then craft_game_review.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

tools.name: craft_task_status
tools.description: Wait up to 15 seconds and read background progress. Continue polling while running; do not end the user task while assets/checks are running.

tools.name: craft_task_cancel
tools.description: Stop this local task and wait for cleanup. For generation tasks also attempt remote queued-task cancellation; processing tasks may continue remotely. Import cancellation stops only the local import.

tools.name: craft_game_review
tools.description: Return the check screenshots as images for visual inspection by the host AI IDE. Inspect actual visuals and referenced resources, composition, clipping, readability and requested transparency.

tools.name: craft_game_deliver
tools.description: Prepare a verified preview after a current passing check and visual review. Craft does not launch the process. Run result.start.script with the external host terminal tool in the background, then poll craft_game_info(name).preview until running=true and snapshot matches this delivery. Verify the page before reporting its URL. The host or OS may reclaim it; restart using the returned command.

tools.name: craft_game_upload
tools.description: When the user asks to upload, transfer the frozen build from a current passing check to a private Craft draft. The same local project, account and platform automatically reuse the saved app ID and append a version. Poll craft_task_status. Reuse the same check_task_id after interruption. draft_ready means the private upload is complete, not published. Use craft_game_deliver and the IDE terminal for local preview.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

check_task_id.description: ID of the passing check for this exact draft build. Reuse the same ID to recover an upload.

tools.name: craft_game_publish_status
tools.description: Query publication review with publication_id, or private upload status with check_task_id. Supply exactly one ID. Only report public publication after this specific version reaches share_completed and returns its verified public_url.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

check_task_id.description: ID of the passing check for this exact draft build. Reuse the same ID to recover an upload.

tools.name: craft_game_publish_open
tools.description: Open an independent local publication page for this passing checked build. Preview the frozen game, edit materials and explicitly confirm the exact reviewed revision before submission. Requires no desktop client. Opening does not submit review. To resume, supply its existing publication_id.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

tools.name: craft_game_publish_options
tools.description: Read the current platform publication category dictionary. Use these game_types/art_styles/play_tags when preparing materials. Public submission requires the platform publication feature and ACE configuration.

tools.name: craft_game_publish_prepare
tools.description: Compatibility headless entry; prefer craft_game_publish_open for the independent local publication page. Prepare materials for a previously uploaded passing check when the user requests public publication. The host AI IDE writes the metadata; Craft captures a real 30-second playtest of the same frozen build. Poll craft_task_status, then call craft_game_publish_review. This does not upload publication images or submit review.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

open_to_recreate.description: Must remain false: external dist-only uploads do not contain editable project sources. Show this restriction in the user confirmation.

cover_path.description: Optional project-relative PNG/JPEG of at most 2 MiB. Omit to use a real game screenshot as cover.

cover_image_source.description: 1 for an AI generated cover; 2 for uploaded/captured material.

tools.name: craft_game_publish_review
tools.description: Return the final publication metadata, revision, cover and real display screenshots. Show them to the user and obtain confirmation of this exact revision before submitting. Images become public URLs on upload; game files remain private until platform review passes.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

publication_id.description: The durable publication_id returned by preparation. Reuse it after interruption.

tools.name: craft_game_publish_submit
tools.description: Only after the user confirms the exact materials shown by craft_game_publish_review: upload images and submit the fixed game version to platform review. Pass confirmed=true and the displayed revision. Reuse publication_id/revision after timeout. Task completion means submitted, not published; query craft_game_publish_status with publication_id until this version completes or fails review.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

publication_id.description: The durable publication_id returned by preparation. Reuse it after interruption.

tools.name: craft_preview_stop
tools.description: Stop this project host-launched preview and cancel pending starts, including an earlier session preview.

name.description: Stable local project name. Reuse it for follow-up edits.

tools.name: craft_auth_open
tools.description: Check login first. Return a login URL only when unauthenticated; an authenticated account continues without a login URL. Image generation uses automatic platform billing. Never read credentials or automate login.

tools.name: craft_auth_status
tools.description: Check the Craft account without exposing credentials.

tools.name: craft_auth_logout
tools.description: Forget this local profile login; does not cancel platform generation.

instructions:
---
name: craft-game-maker
description: Make or modify local Craft 2D/Phaser and 3D/Three.js games in AI IDEs, including AI assets, gameplay checks and preview.
---

# Craft 本地小游戏制作

Craft MCP 提供工程、素材召回、AIGC、构建、验收与预览能力。制作流程以用户需求、当前工程及本指南为准。

## 默认交互

素材来源、获取方式、使用顺序与表现方式遵守当前引擎 `AGENTS.md`、相关技能及用户要求。`craft_game_info` 的 library / aigc 字段分别列出可用的召回分类与生成类型。调用 AIGC 时使用实际返回的产物；生成按平台规则自动扣分，不要求工程额度或逐项确认。短音效生成已下线，音频召回仍可用。

使用平台能力前调用 `craft_auth_status`。已登录直接继续；仅未登录时展示工具返回的 `user_message`，不自行拼地址。`auth_mode:token` 由用户在 宿主凭证设置或连接器表单更新凭证并重新连接；普通安装由用户在工具返回的本机页面登录。连接后复用原工程和请求继续。网络错误不要求重新登录；积分不足或服务失败如实报告并保留记录。

禁止读取凭据文件、自动填写登录页或连接器凭证表单，或要求用户把 Token 发到聊天、写配置；链接中不得带 Token。

后台任务、素材接线、测试、看图和修复持续推进，直到交付或明确受阻；需要用户登录、用户取消时停下说明。交付预览链接、玩法和操作键；生成过图片时附资源 ID 与原始资源 URL。

使用召回时，按工程引擎提交 1～8 个 slot/category/query，轮询后检查候选、score、metadata 和错误。选中后用 `craft_assets_import` 传 `source:"library"`、search_id、candidate_id、slot、request_key；一批只含一种来源。AssetId 不当作 AIGC resource_id，不手填或猜测候选外的资源地址。搜索操作本身不生成素材；后续素材决策遵守当前引擎上下文与用户要求，不因错误换 key 盲重试，也不把召回素材冒充 AI 产物。

## 连续工作流

MCP 的 `workspace` 是游戏父目录，实际游戏为 `<workspace>/<name>`，不自动跟随 WorkBuddy 当前工作目录。默认 `~/CraftGames`；可在宿主 MCP 环境配置中显式设置 `CLIENT_WORKSPACE_ROOT`，或用 `craft-mcp --workspace <绝对父目录>` 启动。修改设置后重连并核对 `craft_game_info.workspace`。准备完成后将返回的 `project` 打开为宿主工作目录。

prepare 会维护项目根 `AGENTS.md` 的 Craft 段，并为已选择的宿主生成项目恢复 Skill；实际路径以返回的 `project_context.entrypoint` 和 `project_context.skill` 为准。未指定宿主时不生成宿主专用目录。用户已有正文保留，同名用户 Skill 不覆盖，结果会标记 `preserved_user_file`。项目的 `.craft/context-lock.json` 固定上下文版本；恢复时核对 `context_binding.status` 为 `bound`，读取 `context.engine.skills_index`，按描述选择当前引擎技能，再相对于 `context.engine.directory` 读取其 entrypoint。缺少绑定时由 prepare 核验后建立；缺包、不兼容或校验失败时先按诊断修复，不静默换用当前安装包的资料。

项目事实放在 SPEC 设计文档与 `SPEC/PROGRESS.md`；prepare 只在进度文件缺失时建立初始记录，不替换已有内容。开始工作先读取这些记录并核对源码；完成开发、验收或遇到阻塞后更新玩法、操作、已完成/待办、关键文件、验收任务与下一步。新会话据此恢复，不依赖上一轮聊天或宿主个人记忆。只读请求不写进度。

1. **先读引擎说明，再制作游戏。** 新建时仅展示 2D / Phaser（js）和 3D / Three.js（js3d）。沿用用户明确选择；尚未明确时按玩法推荐并收集选择，用户授权代选时直接决定并说明。选定后调用 `craft_game_info(engine)`；继续游戏用 `craft_game_info(name)` 获取已保存的引擎，不重新选择。开始设计、编码或修改前完整读取 `context.engine.entrypoint`，其余参考文档按需加载。
2. 调用 `craft_game_prepare`，使用稳定的英文 name；新建时传 engine，继续时复用原 name、沿用引擎。必须轮询成功后才用 AI IDE 文件工具编辑工程，遵循返回的 instructions/context。工程由本会话占用至 Craft 断开；遇到 CRAFT_PROJECT_IN_USE 时回原会话继续或请用户关闭原会话的 Craft，不绕过锁写文件、不终止其他进程。并行制作使用不同 name。保留模板依赖、runtime、Vite、预览接线和配置结构。
3. 按当前引擎上下文与用户要求选定的素材方案调用对应工具。使用召回时遵守上述候选导入契约；调用 `craft_assets_generate(name,assets)` 时每批 1～8 项，用 kind 选择 image/image_edit、static_mesh、skeletal_mesh、music、video、sprite_sheet 或 animation。图片按画面选尺寸，角色/道具图可设 `transparent:true`；动画需要视频和宿主骨骼 ID。slot、request_key 保持稳定；恢复用原 key 和全部参数，仅用户要求重做时新建 key。已有 AIGC 任务用 `craft_assets_import` 按 resource_id 导入，禁止另行 curl 下载或重复付费生成。
4. 返回 task_id 后，用 `craft_task_status(wait_ms:15000)` 轮询至终态；等待生成时可写独立逻辑。遇到 login 展示工具登录链接；asset_preview 则请用户在 Craft 资源中心完成预览确认后复用原请求继续，不自动冒充预览通过。failed/interrupted 查看错误并保留记录，资源未完成不宣称完成。取消用 `craft_task_cancel`，远端 processing 可能继续；导入任务取消只停止本地导入。
5. 平台没有请求级幂等：超时或提交响应丢失时保留原 key，只查询认领原任务，不盲目重发付费请求；查询未找到不代表未扣分，提交未确认时稍后用原参数重试。
6. 按工具返回的 `config_file` 和 slot 接线，保留资源原值：AIGC 写平台返回的 `result_url`，召回写候选原始 Path；不下载到 `public/assets/generated/`，不把平台相对路径改成游戏站点路径。按当前引擎的资源 URL 门禁和加载规范使用官方 CDN、`resolveAssetUrl` 与 `gameConfig()`；不要在源码硬编码资源地址。AIGC `PaperFlipbook` 保存 manifest JSON 地址，召回序列帧保存图集 PNG 地址并使用同一候选的 `sprite` 布局。导出按原始面板规则对官方域和百分号编码做归一化，召回路径保留其合法前缀，不改成本地素材地址；检查导出后的实际配置，不把合法解码又改回编码。模型、贴图、音频及清单依赖由原始加载管线实际读取，资源不可访问时报告失败，不以只写配置代替接线。
7. 调用 `craft_game_check` 执行引擎收尾、构建和浏览器采集。依次提供 `loop`、`settlement`、`restart` 三步，每步包含 action、expected 和真实玩法断言。
8. gate.passed 后调用 `craft_game_review`，逐一查看初始、主循环、结算、重开四张截图，检查素材、构图、比例、文字、遮挡、透明边缘和玩法反馈；有问题就修复并重验。浏览器或截图不可用时报告未验证。
9. 玩法和视觉均通过后，调用 `craft_game_deliver(task_id,visual_passed:true,visual_notes)`，填写实际观察。返回 awaiting_host_start 时，由 AI IDE 使用后台终端执行 `start.script` 并保持该任务运行；这是持续服务命令，不等待终端退出才查询状态。Craft 不启动预览。轮询 `craft_game_info(name).preview`，直到 running=true 且 snapshot 与此次交付一致，打开返回 URL 确认画布能启动后才交付链接；直接打开源码 index.html 不能替代预览。预览可能被宿主或系统回收；失效时查看 start.logs，重跑启动命令并验证，用 `craft_preview_stop(name)` 停止。源码或构建产物变化后重新检查、交付。

用户要求上传 Craft 私有草稿时，先通过检查与看图，再调用 `craft_game_upload(name,check_task_id)`。同一目录、name、账号和平台自动复用 appid，修改后重新检查上传只新增版本；中断时保留原 check_task_id 重试。发布与本地预览使用相同的资源配置：保留 AIGC 原始 URL、召回原始相对路径，按引擎配置解析 CDN；同时验证远端资源在目标浏览器和公开托管中实际可用。用 `craft_task_status` 等待上传，用 `craft_game_publish_status(name,check_task_id)` 查询同一版本。`draft_ready` 表示私有上传完成，交付项目 ID、版本 ID 与摘要，不代表公开发布，也不提供云端预览链接。试玩与交付预览沿用 IDE 本地的 `craft_game_deliver` 启动流程，不以云端试玩作为上传完成条件。

用户要求公开发布时，优先调用 `craft_game_publish_open(name,check_task_id)` 并向用户展示返回的本地发布页链接。页面可编辑材料、查看验收冻结版本和最终图片，使用原有 30 秒真实采集；只有用户勾选确认具体 revision 后才上传公开图片并提审。页面不依赖安装桌面客户端；同一 publication_id 可重新打开恢复。发布完成以目标版本审核完成及公开链接为准。

需要由工具准备材料时，先完成私有上传，调用 `craft_game_publish_options` 获取当前分类。AI IDE 根据游戏准备名称、简介/操作说明、分类、标签和封面；封面可用工程内 PNG/JPEG，省略时使用真实游戏截图。调用 `craft_game_publish_prepare(name,check_task_id,materials)`，轮询完成；MCP 对同一冻结版本真实试玩至少 30 秒，生成展示图和审核抽帧，不用四张普通验收图冒充完整采集。

随后调用 `craft_game_publish_review(name,publication_id)`，向用户展示完整文案、封面、截图、目标版本、是否开放二创，以及图片上传后为公开 URL 的事实。取得用户对本次 `revision` 的明确确认后，才调用 `craft_game_publish_submit(name,publication_id,revision,confirmed:true)`。材料变化须重新准备、看图和确认；准备完成不表示获得了提交授权。

提交任务完成只表示已发起审核。用 `craft_game_publish_status(name,publication_id)` 查询，保留原 ID 恢复超时；只有当前版本 `share_completed` 且返回匹配的 `public_url` 才报告发布成功。审核失败展示原因并修改后重新准备；审核未启用、缺材料或仍在等待时不冒充通过。公开发布能力以当前服务返回的开关和审核状态为准。

若状态返回 `finalization_retry_required:true`，审核已经通过但最终存储收尾需要重试；复用原 publication_id、revision 和既有确认调用 submit，只恢复同一份已审材料的收尾，不重新准备或另发审核。

已公开的同一版本只支持原 publication_id 的幂等重试。修改已公开作品的文案或图片时，重新检查并上传新版本（保留 appid），再准备和确认新材料；旧线上版本在新版本审核期间保持不变。外部包只有 dist，不包含可编辑源码，`open_to_recreate` 必须为 false。

## 引擎参考上下文

连接时发送通用指南，选定引擎后的 info/prepare 结果附专用指南。`context.workflow` 为通用指南，`context.engine.guide` 为专用指南，`context.engine.directory` 为引擎上下文，`context.references` 为按需文档。

引擎 `AGENTS.md`、相关技能及用户要求决定素材策略；本指南定义 Craft MCP 的调用流程。`craft_game_check` 包含配置导出、构建和采集；`craft_game_review` 返回实际截图供审阅，检查布局、地面接触、尺寸、裁剪、可读性及所需透明效果。保留模板的渲染、就绪、资源释放和配置导出行为。

## 玩法观测

验收前必须确保工程已显式安装 `globalThis.__GAME_PROBE__.snapshot()`，不能假设模板自带探针；缺少时先补齐，再调用 `craft_game_check`。旧工程已有探针时保留并扩展。快照返回真实 `engine`、`ready`、`frameCount`，`game` 从实际玩法状态读取，如 `{score,phase,round}`。

`frameCount` 只能随真实渲染帧递增。必要资源加载成功且实际场景已渲染后才允许 `ready` 成立：Phaser 结合 `POST_RENDER`、`markPreviewReady` 和活跃的 `PlayScene`，Three.js 结合实际 render 帧与资源加载。保留引擎预览生命周期，不伪造帧数、就绪或玩法状态使检查通过。

测试使用真实输入，不直接改分数或强行结算。Canvas 用坐标，DOM 用 target；`qa:` 仅路由到与玩家操作相同的处理函数，每步 ms ≤ 30000。

示例（按实际玩法调整）：
```json
[
  {"phase":"loop","action":"press","key":"Space","ms":300,"expected":"接到一颗星，分数增加","assertions":[{"path":"game.score","operator":"gte","value":1}]},
  {"phase":"settlement","action":"wait","ms":15000,"expected":"倒计时结束显示结算","assertions":[{"path":"game.phase","operator":"eq","value":"over"}]},
  {"phase":"restart","action":"click","target":"再玩一次","expected":"新一局分数归零","assertions":[{"path":"game.phase","operator":"eq","value":"playing"},{"path":"game.score","operator":"eq","value":0}]}
]
```
